DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HIROSAKI-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HIROSAKI-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんばんは。受付で何をお手伝いできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HIROSAKI-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Good evening. How can I help you at reception?

DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HIROSAKI-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HIROSAKI-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 家族が先に説明しましたが、症状が始まった時刻を訂正したいです。私自身のことで受診に来ました。
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HIROSAKI-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 家族が先に説明した発症時刻を本人として訂正したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HIROSAKI-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: My family explained first, but I would like to correct the time my symptoms began. I am here to see a doctor for myself.
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HIROSAKI-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that, as the patient, you want to correct the onset time your family gave earlier. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HIROSAKI-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HIROSAKI-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: ご本人のお話を伺います。どの説明を直したいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HIROSAKI-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: We will listen to you directly. Which part of the explanation would you like to correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HIROSAKI-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HIROSAKI-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 家族は今朝からと言いましたが、腹痛が始まったのは今日の夕方六時ごろです。今も続いています。
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HIROSAKI-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 今朝ではなく今日の夕方六時ごろから腹痛が始まり、現在も続いていると訂正する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HIROSAKI-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: My family said this morning, but my stomach pain began around six this evening. It is still continuing.
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HIROSAKI-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Correct the information: your stomach pain began around six this evening, rather than this morning, and is still continuing. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HIROSAKI-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HIROSAKI-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 夕方六時ごろから続いているのですね。担当の職員へ訂正を伝えます。ほかに伝えたいことはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HIROSAKI-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: So it has continued since around six this evening. I will pass the correction to the staff member in charge. Is there anything else you would like to tell us?

DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HIROSAKI-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HIROSAKI-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 普段飲んでいる薬があります。名前を覚えていないので、持ってきた薬の袋を担当の方に見てもらいたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HIROSAKI-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 普段飲む薬の名前を覚えていないため、持参した薬の袋を担当者に見てほしいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HIROSAKI-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: There is medicine I take regularly. I do not remember its name, so I would like the person in charge to look at the medicine bag I brought.
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HIROSAKI-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain that you cannot remember the name of your regular medicine and want the person in charge to look at the medicine bag you brought. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HIROSAKI-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HIROSAKI-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 袋をお預かりして引き継ぎます。説明はご本人から続けられますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HIROSAKI-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: I will take the bag and hand it over. Can you continue explaining for yourself?

DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HIROSAKI-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HIROSAKI-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 日本語で話せますが、質問は一つずつお願いします。わからない言葉は家族に聞いてもらいたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HIROSAKI-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 日本語で説明するが質問は一つずつ希望し、不明な言葉は家族の助けを借りたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HIROSAKI-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: I can speak Japanese, but please ask me one question at a time. For words I do not understand, I would like my family to help me ask about them.
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HIROSAKI-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain that you will speak in Japanese, but want questions one at a time and your family's help with words you do not understand. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HIROSAKI-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HIROSAKI-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: そのご希望も伝えます。待っている間に状態が変わったら、すぐ職員に知らせてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HIROSAKI-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: I will pass on that request too. If your condition changes while you are waiting, please tell a staff member immediately.

DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HIROSAKI-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HIROSAKI-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 発症は夕方六時ごろで、薬の袋を確認してほしいと伝わっていますね。変化があれば我慢せず知らせます。
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HIROSAKI-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 発症時刻と薬の袋の引継ぎを確認し、待機中に状態が変われば知らせると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HIROSAKI-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: You have passed on that the symptoms began around six this evening and that I want the medicine bag checked, correct? If anything changes, I will tell someone without trying to endure it.
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HIROSAKI-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm that the onset time and medicine bag have been passed on, and say you will report any change in your condition while waiting. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HIROSAKI-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HIROSAKI-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: その内容を担当へ引き継ぎました。ご相談ありがとうございました。ご本人に確認しながら対応します。
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HIROSAKI-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: I have handed that information over to the person in charge. Thank you for speaking with us. We will check with you directly as we assist you.

DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HIROSAKI-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HIROSAKI-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。改札で何かお困りですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HIROSAKI-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. Are you having trouble at the ticket gate?

DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HIROSAKI-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HIROSAKI-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この切符で入れませんでした。買い直す前に、使えない理由を見ていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HIROSAKI-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 切符で入場できず、買い直す前に理由を確認してほしいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HIROSAKI-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: I could not get in with this ticket. Before I buy another one, could you check why it will not work?
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HIROSAKI-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that your ticket would not let you enter, and ask staff to check why before you buy another one. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HIROSAKI-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HIROSAKI-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 日付を確認します。こちらは昨日お使いになった切符のようです。今日の切符も購入しましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HIROSAKI-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let me check the date. This appears to be the ticket you used yesterday. Did you also buy a ticket for today?

DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HIROSAKI-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HIROSAKI-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい、今朝買いました。昨日の切符を同じ財布に入れていたので、取り違えたかもしれません。
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HIROSAKI-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 今日の切符も購入済みで、同じ財布の前日の切符と取り違えた可能性を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HIROSAKI-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes, I bought one this morning. I put yesterday's ticket in the same wallet, so I may have mixed them up.
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HIROSAKI-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you have already bought today's ticket and may have confused it with yesterday's ticket in the same wallet. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HIROSAKI-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HIROSAKI-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 今日の切符を探してみてください。購入時のレシートだけでは、ここでは入場券の代わりになりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HIROSAKI-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please look for today's ticket. Here, the purchase receipt alone cannot be used instead of an admission ticket.

DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HIROSAKI-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HIROSAKI-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: このレシートしか見つかっていません。すぐにもう一枚買わず、かばんの中も探したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HIROSAKI-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: レシートしか見つからないが二重購入せず、かばんも探したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HIROSAKI-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: I have only found this receipt so far. I would like to look in my bag too, without buying another ticket right away.
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HIROSAKI-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain that you have only found the receipt, but want to search your bag as well without buying a second ticket. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HIROSAKI-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HIROSAKI-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 通路をふさがないよう、横の台でお探しください。列車の出発までは少し時間があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HIROSAKI-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please search at the counter to the side so you do not block the passage. There is still a little time before the train leaves.

DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HIROSAKI-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HIROSAKI-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 内ポケットにありました。こちらが今日の切符です。行き先も日付も見ていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HIROSAKI-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 内ポケットで見つけた今日の切符の行き先と日付を確認してもらう。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HIROSAKI-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: It was in the inner pocket. This is today's ticket. Could you check both the destination and the date?
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HIROSAKI-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask staff to check the destination and date on today's ticket, which you found in an inner pocket. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HIROSAKI-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HIROSAKI-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい、こちらは今日の切符です。今の入場にはこちらを使ってください。昨日の切符とは分けてお持ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HIROSAKI-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes, this is today's ticket. Please use this one to enter now. Keep it separate from yesterday's ticket.

DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HIROSAKI-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HIROSAKI-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 今日の切符で入ります。昨日のものは別の場所にしまい、乗り換える時も今日の切符を出します。
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HIROSAKI-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 今日の切符で入場し、前日の切符は分けてしまい、乗換時も今日のものを使うと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HIROSAKI-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will enter with today's ticket. I will put yesterday's one somewhere separate and take out today's ticket when I change trains too.
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HIROSAKI-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will enter with today's ticket, put yesterday's ticket away separately, and use today's ticket when changing trains too. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HIROSAKI-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HIROSAKI-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: はい、今度はこちらで通れます。お気を付けていってらっしゃいませ。
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HIROSAKI-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Yes, this one will let you through. Have a safe journey.

DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HIROSAKI-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HIROSAKI-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: いらっしゃいませ。お食事について何をお手伝いしましょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HIROSAKI-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Welcome. How can I help you with your meal?

DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HIROSAKI-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HIROSAKI-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 二人で来ましたが、私は少しだけ食べたいです。二人とも同じセットにしないといけませんか。
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HIROSAKI-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 二人のうち自分は少量希望なので、同じセットを注文する必要があるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HIROSAKI-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: There are two of us, but I only want a little to eat. Do we both have to order the same set meal?
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HIROSAKI-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you are one of two diners and want a small amount, and ask whether you must order the same set meal. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HIROSAKI-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HIROSAKI-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この席では単品でも注文できます。どのくらい召し上がりたいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HIROSAKI-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: You can order individual dishes at this table too. How much would you like to eat?

DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HIROSAKI-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HIROSAKI-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 私は冷ややっこと小さいご飯にします。友人は焼き魚と普通のご飯が欲しいそうです。
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HIROSAKI-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 自分は冷ややっこと小さいご飯、友人は焼き魚と普通のご飯を希望すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HIROSAKI-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: I will have chilled tofu and a small serving of rice. My friend would like grilled fish and a regular serving of rice.
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HIROSAKI-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say that you want chilled tofu and a small serving of rice, and your friend wants grilled fish and a regular serving of rice. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HIROSAKI-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HIROSAKI-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 承知しました。小さいご飯と普通のご飯は値段が異なります。メニューのこちらでよろしいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HIROSAKI-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: Certainly. Small and regular servings of rice have different prices. Are these items here on the menu all right?

DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HIROSAKI-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HIROSAKI-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい、この値段で大丈夫です。私の分だけ小さいご飯にしてください。二人とも小さくしないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HIROSAKI-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 表示価格を了承し、小さいご飯は自分の分だけで二人とも小さくしないよう確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HIROSAKI-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes, those prices are fine. Please make only my rice a small serving. Do not make both servings small.
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HIROSAKI-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Accept the displayed prices and confirm that only your serving of rice should be small, rather than both servings. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HIROSAKI-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HIROSAKI-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: ご飯の大きさは別々ですね。冷ややっこは一皿、焼き魚も一皿でよろしいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HIROSAKI-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: So you want different rice sizes. Would that be one dish of chilled tofu and one dish of grilled fish?

DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HIROSAKI-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HIROSAKI-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい、一皿ずつです。二人で分けるセットではなく、それぞれの注文としてお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HIROSAKI-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 冷ややっこと焼き魚は一皿ずつで、分けるセットではなく各人の注文だと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HIROSAKI-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes, one dish of each. Please treat them as our individual orders, rather than a set for the two of us to share.
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HIROSAKI-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain that you want one dish each of chilled tofu and grilled fish as individual orders, rather than a set to share. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HIROSAKI-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HIROSAKI-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 確認します。手前の方が冷ややっこと小さいご飯、奥の方が焼き魚と普通のご飯ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HIROSAKI-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Let me confirm. The person nearer me is having chilled tofu and small rice, and the person farther away is having grilled fish and regular rice, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HIROSAKI-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HIROSAKI-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: その通りです。料理はそれぞれに出していただいて、お会計は最後に一緒にお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HIROSAKI-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 席ごとの料理を確認し、個別に提供して会計は最後に一緒にしてほしいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HIROSAKI-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: That is right. Please serve each person's food separately, and put our bill together at the end.
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HIROSAKI-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm which food goes to each seat, and ask for individual serving with one combined bill at the end. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HIROSAKI-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HIROSAKI-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。ご注文をお受けしました。どうぞおくつろぎください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-HIROSAKI-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Certainly. I have taken your order. Please make yourselves comfortable.

DLG-SC-AOM-MUTSU-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-AOM-MUTSU-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。乗船受付で何をお手伝いできますか。
DLG-SC-AOM-MUTSU-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. How can I help you at the boarding reception?

DLG-SC-AOM-MUTSU-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-AOM-MUTSU-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 二人分の予約がありますが、私の名前の綴りが違っています。受付前に直せますか。
DLG-SC-AOM-MUTSU-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 二人分の予約で自分の名前の綴りに誤りがあり、受付前に訂正したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-AOM-MUTSU-001-SHARED-02.translation: We have a reservation for two, but my name is spelled incorrectly. Can it be corrected before we check in?
DLG-SC-AOM-MUTSU-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you have a reservation for two with a spelling error in your name, and want to correct it before check-in. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-AOM-MUTSU-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-AOM-MUTSU-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 予約番号と、正しいお名前がわかるものをお願いします。
DLG-SC-AOM-MUTSU-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please show me your reservation number and something showing your correct name.

DLG-SC-AOM-MUTSU-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-AOM-MUTSU-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 予約番号はこちらです。名前はこの書類の表記が正しく、予約では一文字抜けています。
DLG-SC-AOM-MUTSU-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 予約番号と書類の正しい表記を示し、予約で一文字抜けていると説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-AOM-MUTSU-001-SHARED-04.translation: Here is the reservation number. The spelling on this document is correct; one letter is missing from the reservation.
DLG-SC-AOM-MUTSU-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show the reservation number and correct spelling on your document, and explain that one letter is missing from the reservation. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-AOM-MUTSU-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-AOM-MUTSU-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 確認しました。一文字の訂正ですね。もう一人のお名前も変更しますか。
DLG-SC-AOM-MUTSU-001-SHARED-05.translation: I have checked. It is a one-letter correction. Would you like to change the other person's name too?

DLG-SC-AOM-MUTSU-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-AOM-MUTSU-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: もう一人は合っています。私の姓名の順序も、書類と同じ順にしていただきたいです。
DLG-SC-AOM-MUTSU-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 同行者の名前は合っており、自分の姓名の順序も書類に合わせたいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-AOM-MUTSU-001-SHARED-06.translation: The other person's name is correct. I would also like my family and given names in the same order as on the document.
DLG-SC-AOM-MUTSU-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain that your companion's name is correct, and ask to have your own family and given names ordered as on the document. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-AOM-MUTSU-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-AOM-MUTSU-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 変更内容を画面に出しました。綴りと順序をご覧ください。
DLG-SC-AOM-MUTSU-001-SHARED-07.translation: The changes are on the screen. Please check the spelling and order.

DLG-SC-AOM-MUTSU-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-AOM-MUTSU-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 綴りも順序も合っています。二人分の予約と出発時刻は変わっていませんか。
DLG-SC-AOM-MUTSU-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 修正された綴りと順序を確認し、人数と出発時刻が変わっていないか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-AOM-MUTSU-001-SHARED-08.translation: Both the spelling and order are correct. Are the reservation for two and the departure time unchanged?
DLG-SC-AOM-MUTSU-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Confirm the corrected spelling and name order, and ask whether the number of passengers and departure time are unchanged. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-AOM-MUTSU-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-AOM-MUTSU-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 予約人数と便は変更していません。新しい確認画面をお渡しします。
DLG-SC-AOM-MUTSU-001-SHARED-09.translation: We have not changed the passenger count or sailing. I will give you the new confirmation screen.

DLG-SC-AOM-MUTSU-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-AOM-MUTSU-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: これからは新しい画面を使います。古い画面と取り違えないよう、保存し直します。
DLG-SC-AOM-MUTSU-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 新しい確認画面を保存し直し、古いものと取り違えないようにすると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-AOM-MUTSU-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will use the new screen from now on. I will save it again so I do not confuse it with the old screen.
DLG-SC-AOM-MUTSU-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will save the new confirmation screen again and avoid confusing it with the old one. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-AOM-MUTSU-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-AOM-MUTSU-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: はい、この画面で受付へお進みください。お気を付けてご乗船ください。
DLG-SC-AOM-MUTSU-001-SHARED-11.translation: Yes, please go to check-in with this screen. Have a safe sailing.

DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-MUTSU-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-MUTSU-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。受付で何をご希望でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-MUTSU-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. What would you like at reception?

DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-MUTSU-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-MUTSU-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 御朱印をお願いしたいです。この帳面の、付箋を付けた頁に書いていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-MUTSU-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 御朱印帳の付箋を付けた頁への記入を依頼する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-MUTSU-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: I would like a goshuin seal inscription. Could you write it on the page in this book marked with a sticky note?
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-MUTSU-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask for the goshuin inscription on the page marked with a sticky note in your seal book. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-MUTSU-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-MUTSU-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この空白の頁ですね。手前にも空白がありますが、そこは空けておきますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-MUTSU-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: This blank page, correct? There is a blank page before it too; would you like to leave that one empty?

DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-MUTSU-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-MUTSU-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい、手前は別の参拝のために空けています。順番に詰めず、付箋の頁をお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-MUTSU-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 手前の空白頁は別の参拝用に残し、順番に詰めず付箋の頁を使ってほしいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-MUTSU-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes, I am saving the earlier page for another visit to worship. Please use the marked page rather than filling the pages consecutively.
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-MUTSU-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you are saving the earlier blank page for another worship visit, and want the marked page used rather than filling pages consecutively. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-MUTSU-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-MUTSU-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 承知しました。こちらの頁に記入する受付ができます。日付は今日の日付でよろしいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-MUTSU-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: Certainly. We can accept your request for an inscription on this page. Shall we use today's date?

DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-MUTSU-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-MUTSU-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 今日の日付でお願いします。以前の日付に合わせて書き直していただく必要はありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-MUTSU-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 今日の日付を希望し、以前の日付に合わせた書直しは不要だと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-MUTSU-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: Today's date, please. There is no need to rewrite it to match an earlier date.
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-MUTSU-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask for today's date and explain that rewriting to match an earlier date is unnecessary. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-MUTSU-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-MUTSU-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: では、この頁でお預かりします。お返しする際に番号札で確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-MUTSU-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Then I will take the book for this page. We will check your numbered token when returning it.

DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-MUTSU-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-MUTSU-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: この番号札を持って待ちます。待っている間に参拝へ行っても大丈夫ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-MUTSU-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 番号札を持って待ち、待機中に参拝に行ってよいか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-MUTSU-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will keep this numbered token while I wait. Is it all right to go and worship while I am waiting?
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-MUTSU-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will keep the numbered token while waiting, and ask whether you may go and worship in the meantime. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-MUTSU-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-MUTSU-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい、戻られたらこちらで番号札をお見せください。今日の受付は四時までです。
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-MUTSU-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes. When you return, please show the numbered token here. Today's reception closes at four.

DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-MUTSU-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-MUTSU-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 四時より前に戻ります。付箋の頁と今日の日付でお願いした内容も、受取り時に確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-MUTSU-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 四時前に戻り、指定頁と今日の日付も受取り時に確認すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-MUTSU-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will return before four. When I collect it, I will also check that the request was for the marked page and today's date.
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-MUTSU-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will return before four and check the specified page and today's date when collecting the book. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-MUTSU-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-MUTSU-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。番号札をなくさずにお持ちください。いってらっしゃいませ。
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-MUTSU-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Certainly. Please keep your numbered token safe. See you when you return.

DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-MUTSU-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-MUTSU-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 作業について、報告したいことはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-MUTSU-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is there anything you would like to report about the work?

DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-MUTSU-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-MUTSU-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 日付の見本と、いま印字されたラベルの日付が違います。貼る前に確認をお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-MUTSU-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 見本と印字ラベルの日付が違うため、貼付け前の確認を依頼する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-MUTSU-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: The date on the sample differs from the date on the labels just printed. Please check before we attach them.
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-MUTSU-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that the sample and printed labels have different dates, and ask for a check before attaching them. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-MUTSU-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-MUTSU-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: ラベルを貼った商品はありますか。違いはどの部分ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-MUTSU-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: Have any labels been attached to products? Which part is different?

DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-MUTSU-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-MUTSU-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 私はまだ貼っていません。見本は十月三日ですが、印字は十月二日になっています。
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-MUTSU-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 自分は未貼付けで、見本が十月三日、印字が十月二日だと具体的に報告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-MUTSU-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: I have not attached any yet. The sample says October third, but the printing says October second.
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-MUTSU-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Report specifically that you have not attached any labels, that the sample says October third, and that the printing says October second. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-MUTSU-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-MUTSU-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: そのラベルは使わず、確認待ちにしてください。何枚印字されていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-MUTSU-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: Do not use those labels; hold them pending confirmation. How many have been printed?

DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-MUTSU-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-MUTSU-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 手元には二十枚あります。ほかの作業台の分は確認していないので、全部で何枚かはわかりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-MUTSU-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 手元は二十枚で、他の作業台は未確認のため全体数は不明だと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-MUTSU-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: I have twenty here. I have not checked the ones at the other workstations, so I do not know the total number.
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-MUTSU-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain that you have twenty labels, but do not know the total because you have not checked the other workstations. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-MUTSU-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-MUTSU-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 二十枚はこちらで確認します。機械の設定は変更しましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-MUTSU-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: We will check those twenty. Have you changed the machine settings?

DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-MUTSU-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-MUTSU-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 変更していません。自分で日付を直して再印刷せず、責任者の確認を待っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-MUTSU-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 機械設定を変えておらず、自分で訂正や再印刷せず責任者の確認を待つと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-MUTSU-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: No, I have not. I am waiting for the supervisor to check, without correcting the date or reprinting them myself.
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-MUTSU-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you have not changed the machine settings and will wait for the supervisor's check without making corrections or reprinting yourself. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-MUTSU-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-MUTSU-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 責任者が見本と製造記録を照合します。確認中は別の作業の指示を受けてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-MUTSU-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: The supervisor will compare the sample with the production records. While that is being checked, get instructions for another task.

DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-MUTSU-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-MUTSU-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: この二十枚を区別して渡します。ほかの台にも同じラベルがある可能性を伝え、次の作業は指示を受けます。
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-MUTSU-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 二十枚を区別して渡し、他の台にもある可能性を報告し、次の作業指示を受けると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-MUTSU-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will keep these twenty separate and hand them over. I will report that the other workstations may have the same labels, and get instructions for my next task.
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-MUTSU-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will hand over the twenty separately, report that the same labels may be at other workstations, and get instructions for the next task. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-MUTSU-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-MUTSU-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 報告ありがとうございます。使用再開の判断はこちらで行い、改めて指示します。
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-MUTSU-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Thank you for reporting this. We will decide when use can resume and give you further instructions.

DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-MUTSU-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-MUTSU-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: おはようございます。作業前に確認したいことはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-MUTSU-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Good morning. Is there anything you want to check before starting work?

DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-MUTSU-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-MUTSU-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 無線で担当の区画番号を聞きましたが、六か七かわかりませんでした。地図で確認できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-MUTSU-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 無線の区画番号が六か七か聞き取れず、地図で確認したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-MUTSU-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: I heard my assigned plot number over the radio, but could not tell whether it was six or seven. Could we check on the map?
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-MUTSU-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you could not distinguish plot six from seven over the radio, and want to check the map. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-MUTSU-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-MUTSU-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 今日の担当は六です。今いる場所を地図で示せますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-MUTSU-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: You are assigned to six today. Can you show your current location on the map?

DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-MUTSU-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-MUTSU-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 入口の橋の横です。七へ続く道の近くにいますが、まだ田んぼには入っていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-MUTSU-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 入口の橋の横にいて、七への道に近いが田んぼには未入場だと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-MUTSU-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: I am beside the bridge at the entrance. I am near the road leading to seven, but I have not entered the rice field yet.
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-MUTSU-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you are beside the entrance bridge, near the road to seven, but have not entered the rice field. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-MUTSU-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-MUTSU-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: そこから六へ行くには、この右側の道を使ってください。橋の先は今、別の班が作業しています。
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-MUTSU-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: To reach six from there, use this road on the right. Another team is currently working beyond the bridge.

DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-MUTSU-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-MUTSU-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 橋を渡らず、右側の道ですね。道具は入口に置いてあるものを持っていけばよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-MUTSU-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 橋を渡らず右側の道を使うと確認し、持参する道具を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-MUTSU-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: So I should take the road on the right without crossing the bridge. Should I take the tools placed at the entrance?
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-MUTSU-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Confirm that you should use the road on the right without crossing the bridge, and ask which tools to bring. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-MUTSU-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-MUTSU-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 担当ごとに道具が分かれています。六の札が付いた組を受け取ってください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-MUTSU-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: The tools are divided by assignment. Please collect the set labeled six.

DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-MUTSU-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-MUTSU-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 六の道具を受け取ります。七の札の道具は触らず、担当と区画を合わせて持っていきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-MUTSU-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 六の札の道具を受け取り、七の道具には触らず担当区画を合わせると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-MUTSU-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will collect the tools for six. I will leave the tools labeled seven alone and take the tools that match my assigned plot.
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-MUTSU-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will collect the tools labeled six, leave seven's tools alone, and match the tools to your assigned plot. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-MUTSU-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-MUTSU-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい。到着したら六の担当者へ声をかけて、作業開始の指示を受けてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-MUTSU-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes. On arrival, speak to the person in charge of six and get instructions to begin work.

DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-MUTSU-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-MUTSU-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 右側の道で六へ行き、担当者に到着を伝えます。番号を聞き取れない時は、そのまま進まず確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-MUTSU-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 六の担当者へ到着を報告し、番号を聞き取れない時は進む前に確認すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-MUTSU-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will take the road on the right to six and tell the person in charge I have arrived. If I cannot make out a number, I will check instead of continuing on.
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-MUTSU-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will report your arrival to the person in charge of six, and check before proceeding whenever you cannot make out a number. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-MUTSU-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-MUTSU-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: そのようにお願いします。お気を付けて移動してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-MUTSU-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please do that. Take care on your way there.

DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-MUTSU-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-MUTSU-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: おはようございます。ご注文について何をご希望ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-MUTSU-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Good morning. What would you like to order?

DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-MUTSU-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-MUTSU-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 朝食セットをお願いします。先に温かい飲み物だけ出していただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-MUTSU-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 朝食セットを注文し、温かい飲物だけ先に出してほしいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-MUTSU-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: I would like the breakfast set. Could you bring just the hot drink first?
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-MUTSU-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Order the breakfast set and ask for just the hot drink to be served first. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-MUTSU-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-MUTSU-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: お急ぎで、食事はお持ち帰りでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-MUTSU-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: Are you in a hurry, and will the food be to take away?

DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-MUTSU-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-MUTSU-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: いいえ、食事もここで食べます。待っている間に飲み物を少し飲みたいだけです。
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-MUTSU-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 持帰りではなく店内で食事も取り、待つ間に飲物を飲みたいだけだと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-MUTSU-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: No, I will eat the food here too. I just want to have a little of the drink while I wait.
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-MUTSU-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you will eat in rather than take away, and only want to have your drink while waiting. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-MUTSU-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-MUTSU-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: わかりました。コーヒーと紅茶から選べます。どちらにしますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-MUTSU-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Understood. You can choose coffee or tea. Which would you like?

DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-MUTSU-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-MUTSU-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 紅茶にします。砂糖は使いませんが、ミルクは別に添えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-MUTSU-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 紅茶を選び、砂糖は不要だがミルクは別添えを希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-MUTSU-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: Tea, please. I do not use sugar, but please serve the milk separately.
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-MUTSU-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Choose tea, say you do not need sugar, and ask for milk on the side. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-MUTSU-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-MUTSU-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 紅茶を先に、パンと卵はできあがってからお持ちします。お連れ様も同じ順序ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-MUTSU-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: I will bring the tea first, and the bread and eggs when they are ready. Would your companion like the same serving order?

DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-MUTSU-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-MUTSU-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 私は一人です。向かいの席の方とは別の客なので、そちらの注文は変えないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-MUTSU-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 一人客で向かいの客とは別なので、その人の注文を変更しないよう伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-MUTSU-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: I am here alone. The person in the seat opposite is a separate customer, so please do not change their order.
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-MUTSU-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain that you are alone and the customer opposite is separate, and ask staff not to change that person's order. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-MUTSU-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-MUTSU-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 失礼しました。お一人分ですね。会計は食後にお願いしています。
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-MUTSU-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: My mistake. One person's order, then. Payment is after the meal.

DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-MUTSU-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-MUTSU-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 一人分の紅茶を先に、食事は後でお願いします。食べ終わってから会計します。
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-MUTSU-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 一人分の紅茶が先、食事が後と確認し、食後に会計すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-MUTSU-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: Please bring one person's tea first and the food afterward. I will pay after I finish eating.
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-MUTSU-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm that one person's tea comes first and the food later, and say you will pay after the meal. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-MUTSU-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-MUTSU-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。まず紅茶をお持ちします。ごゆっくりどうぞ。
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-MUTSU-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Certainly. I will bring the tea first. Please enjoy your time here.

DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-MUTSU-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-MUTSU-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。準備でわからないことはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-MUTSU-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. Is there anything you do not understand about the preparation?

DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-MUTSU-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-MUTSU-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この材料表は四人分ですか。四人で同じ台を使うので、量を確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-MUTSU-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 四人で使う台の材料表が四人分か確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-MUTSU-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: Is this ingredient list for four people? Four of us are using the same worktable, so I would like to check the quantities.
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-MUTSU-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Check whether the ingredient list at the worktable shared by four people is for four servings. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-MUTSU-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-MUTSU-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 表は二人分です。一つの台で二組に分かれて作ります。もう材料を量りましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-MUTSU-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: The list is for two people. At each table, you will cook in two pairs. Have you already measured the ingredients?

DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-MUTSU-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-MUTSU-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: まだです。四人分だと思って全部を二倍にするところでした。調味料も加えていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-MUTSU-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: まだ計量や調味料の追加はしておらず、誤解して二倍にするところだったと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-MUTSU-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: Not yet. I thought it was for four and was about to double everything. I have not added any seasonings either.
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-MUTSU-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you have not measured anything or added seasonings yet, and were about to double the quantities because of a misunderstanding. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-MUTSU-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-MUTSU-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: では、右の二人と左の二人で別々に作りましょう。どちらの組を担当しますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-MUTSU-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: Then let the two people on the right and the two on the left cook separately. Which pair are you in?

DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-MUTSU-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-MUTSU-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 私は右の組です。同じ名前のボウルがあるので、自分の組の物を区別したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-MUTSU-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 右の組を担当すると伝え、似たボウルから自分の組の物を区別したいと相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-MUTSU-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: I am in the pair on the right. There are bowls with the same name, so I would like to distinguish our pair's bowls.
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-MUTSU-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you are in the pair on the right, and ask how to distinguish your pair's bowls from similar ones. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-MUTSU-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-MUTSU-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 右の組は青い印のボウルを使ってください。量った材料も、その印のそばへ置いてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-MUTSU-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: The pair on the right should use the bowls with blue marks. Put your measured ingredients beside those marks too.

DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-MUTSU-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-MUTSU-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 青い印でそろえます。左の組の材料をこちらへ足さず、二人分を量ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-MUTSU-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 青い印を使い、左の組の材料は足さず二人分だけを量ると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-MUTSU-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will use the blue marks for everything. I will measure two servings without adding the left pair's ingredients to ours.
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-MUTSU-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will use the blue marks and measure only two servings, without adding the left pair's ingredients. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-MUTSU-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-MUTSU-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: そのやり方で大丈夫です。調味料を加える前に、こちらへ量を見せてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-MUTSU-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: That will be fine. Before adding the seasonings, show me the quantities.

DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-MUTSU-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-MUTSU-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 二人分の表で量り、青い印のボウルを使います。混ぜる前に確認していただきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-MUTSU-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 二人分の表で計量して青い印のボウルを使い、混ぜる前に確認を受けると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-MUTSU-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will measure using the list for two people and use the bowls with blue marks. I will have you check before mixing.
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-MUTSU-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will measure using the two-person list, use the bowls with blue marks, and have them checked before mixing. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-MUTSU-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-MUTSU-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: はい、確認できたら次へ進みましょう。ご質問ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-MUTSU-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Yes, once we have checked, we can proceed. Thank you for asking.

DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-MUTSU-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-MUTSU-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。展望台で何かお困りでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-MUTSU-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. Are you having any trouble at the observation deck?

DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-MUTSU-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-MUTSU-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 風で帽子が柵の外へ落ちました。自分で取りに行かず、こちらへ知らせに来ました。
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-MUTSU-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 帽子が風で柵の外に落ち、自分で拾わず職員に知らせに来たと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-MUTSU-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: The wind blew my hat outside the fence. I came to tell you instead of trying to retrieve it myself.
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-MUTSU-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that the wind blew your hat outside the fence and you came to tell staff without retrieving it yourself. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-MUTSU-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-MUTSU-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 落ちた場所を、安全な所から示せますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-MUTSU-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: Can you indicate where it fell from a safe place?

DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-MUTSU-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-MUTSU-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: あの案内板の右下です。柵の内側から指せますが、外へ出たり身を乗り出したりはしません。
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-MUTSU-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 案内板の右下の位置を内側から示し、柵の外へ出たり身を乗り出したりしないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-MUTSU-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: It is below and to the right of that information board. I can point from inside the fence, but I will not go outside or lean over it.
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-MUTSU-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Indicate the location below and to the right of the information board from inside the fence, and say you will not go outside or lean over it. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-MUTSU-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-MUTSU-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 場所を確認しました。担当が回収できるか判断します。帽子の特徴を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-MUTSU-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: I have located it. The person in charge will decide whether it can be retrieved. Please describe the hat.

DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-MUTSU-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-MUTSU-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: ベージュの帽子で、黒いひもが付いています。見えている物が私のものか、写真でも確認できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-MUTSU-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 帽子はベージュで黒いひもがあり、写真でも自分の物か確認できると説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-MUTSU-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: It is a beige hat with a black cord. I can also use a photo to confirm whether the one we can see is mine.
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-MUTSU-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain that the hat is beige with a black cord, and that you can also confirm from a photo whether it is yours. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-MUTSU-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-MUTSU-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 特徴を記録します。すぐ回収できるとは限りません。結果のご連絡先を伺ってもよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-MUTSU-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: I will record those details. It may not be possible to retrieve it immediately. May I have contact details so we can tell you the outcome?

DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-MUTSU-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-MUTSU-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: この番号へ電話をお願いします。回収できなくても、自分で柵を越えて探すことはしません。
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-MUTSU-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 電話連絡先を伝え、回収不能でも自分で柵を越えて探さないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-MUTSU-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: Please call this number. Even if it cannot be retrieved, I will not climb over the fence to look for it myself.
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-MUTSU-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Give your phone contact and say that even if retrieval is impossible, you will not climb over the fence to search yourself. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-MUTSU-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-MUTSU-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 承知しました。連絡先と落下位置を担当に渡します。今日はこのままお帰りでも大丈夫です。
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-MUTSU-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: Understood. I will pass your contact details and the location where it fell to the person in charge. You may go home now if you wish.

DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-MUTSU-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-MUTSU-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: では帰ります。こちらの控えを残して、回収できたかの連絡を待ちます。
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-MUTSU-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 帰宅して控えを保管し、回収結果の連絡を待つと確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-MUTSU-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: Then I will go home. I will keep this receipt and wait to hear whether it could be retrieved.
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-MUTSU-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm that you will go home, keep your receipt, and wait to be contacted with the retrieval result. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-MUTSU-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-MUTSU-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 控えをお持ちください。ご連絡ありがとうございました。お気を付けてお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AOM-MUTSU-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please take your receipt. Thank you for letting us know. Have a safe journey home.
